results.title: NHL player injury: Colorado Avalanche star forward Nathan MacKinnon to remain absent for an extended period this season
results.description: In a tough blow for the Colorado Avalanche, Nathan MacKinnon is expected to be out for a minimum of one month due to a lower-body injury, while teammate Cale Makar is likely to miss around two weeks for the same reason. Both injuries arose during an overtime defeat against the Ottawa Senators on November 12.

results.title: ‘Pandit Nehru was symbol of peace, secularism’
results.description: City Congress in Prayagraj pays tribute to Jawaharlal Nehru on 137th birth anniversary, calling him a symbol of peace, secularism, and nation-building.

results.title: Recovery agents cannot forcibly take away financed vehicles for payment default: HC
results.description: Allahabad HC: Finance firms can’t use recovery agents or force to seize vehicles for loan defaults; repossession must be through court/arbitration, vehicle released.

results.title: ‘Scholar’ throws light on drug abuse among youth; first look out
results.description: Directed and written by Dr. Bheemagani Sudhakar Goud, the film deals with the increasing drug and cannabis addiction among the youths.
